member.name: T:MelvorModLoader.Loader
member.summary:
Entry point, called by the bootstrap the launcher (Melvor2Modded.exe) injects into GodotPlugins.Game.Main (right after Godot's script bridge is initialized, before any game scene or script runs).
Loads every mods/*/mod.json mod in id order into the game's AssemblyLoadContext, applies its Harmony patches (each patch class separately, so one broken by a game update doesn't disable the rest) and calls its entry points. A failing mod is logged and skipped; it never stops the game from starting.

member.name: T:MelvorModLoader.ModLogger
member.summary: Writes "[prefix] message" to the game's console and log file (%APPDATA%\Games By Malcs\Melvor Idle 2\logs).
member.remarks: Deliberately avoids GD.PushError/PushWarning: mods load before Godot's ProjectSettings singleton exists, and those calls dereference it, crashing the game with an access violation. GD.Print/PrintErr are safe.
